data.summary: Dedicated and detail-oriented Officer with over 10+ years of experience in managing client onboarding processes and demonstrating proficiency in customer satisfaction and risk management. Proven ability to adapt to new environments and drive results through innovative approaches. Passionate about leveraging expertise to optimize business growth.

responsibilities: Leading the team in reducing MTPs by 40%, resulting in a 25% decrease in account opening time and enhanced customer experience.
Conducted regular process audits and identified areas improvement, leading to a 20% reduction in errors and rework.
Collaborated with the compliance department to address any discrepancies or potential risks.
Assisted in training new team members on process procedures.
Reviewing and analyzing tax withholding discrepancies and reversals to ensure accurate financial records.
Resolve account discrepancies by investigating issues, identifying solutions, and implementing corrective actions.
Managed the end-to-end onboarding process for new clients, collecting necessary including conducting due diligence, documentation, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure a smooth transition.
Prepared and presented MIS reports and Dashboards to senior management, summarizing key metrics, trends, and performance indicators related to the onboarding process.
Resolved escalated client issues promptly and effectively, ensuring high client satisfaction and retention.
Handing ICDD (Individual Client Due Diligence) Project Designed and executed test cases while performing functional, integration, and regression testing to ensure application quality

Logged and tracked defects, collaborated with development teams for resolution, and conducted peer reviews to maintain quality standards. Assisted in preparing and submitting tax returns, ensuring accuracy and compliance with tax regulations.
Liaison with the Service team and Fund Transfer regarding smooth client transactions.
KYC updates & Customer Due Diligence (CDD) , Compliance adherence & escalation and perform Reconciliation on weekly / monthly basis.
